param: Ψ Total recruitment (entry) rate into adult susceptible population (all groups combined)
θ Proportion of recruits who are men
γ Proportion of male recruits who are heterosexual men (vs homosexual men)
λₕ Force of infection for susceptible homosexual men (aggregates exclusive homosexual + bisexual contacts as defined in paper/figure)
λ𝓌 Force of infection for susceptible women (aggregates heterosexual contact with infected heterosexual men and bisexual contact with infected homosexual men)
λₘ Force of infection for susceptible heterosexual men (aggregates heterosexual contact with infected women and bisexual contact with infected homosexual men)
α Departure/diagnosis rate from untreated infected classes (leaving I compartments)
p Proportion of departing infected individuals who initiate ART (enter T); remaining (1-p) progress directly to AIDS (enter A)
δ Progression rate from treatment (ART) to AIDS (treatment failure / resistance)
μ Natural mortality rate (applies to all compartments)
d AIDS-induced additional mortality rate (applies only in AIDS compartment A)
